column1: Table S8B. Window-level sensitivity analysis for ONSEN versus non-ONSEN LTR-retrotransposon 800-bp terminal candidate regions.

Sensitivity analysis treats left and right terminal windows as separate observations; the element/copy-level analysis in Table S8A is principal because paired termini from the same TE are not independent. The retained source output did not contain the CG window-level Cliff's delta, so no value was inferred from the P-value or medians.
